sn40.1:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā Mahā-Moggalāno Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
sn40.1:1.2: Tatra kho āyasmā Mahā-Moggalāno bhikkhū āmantesi ||
sn40.1:1.4: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Maha-Moggalānassa paccassosuṃ || || 3
sn40.1:2.1: Idha mayhaṃ āvuso rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn40.1:2.5: Idha bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajam pītisukhaṃ pathamaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharati ||
sn40.1:2.7: So khvāham āvuso vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajam pītisukham pathamaṃ jhānam upasampajja viharāmi ||
sn40.1:2.8: tassa mayham āvuso iminā vihārena viharato kāmasahagatā saññā manasikārā samudācaranti || || 6
sn40.1:3.1: Atha kho mam āvuso Bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etad avoca || ||
sn40.1:3.3: mā brāhmaṇa pathamaṃ jhānaṃ pamādo pathame jhāne cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi pathame jhāne cittaṃ ekodikarohi pathame jhāne cittaṃ samādahāti || || 7
sn40.1:3.4: So khvāham āvuso aparena samayena vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkam savicāram vivekajam pītisukham pathamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ || || 8
sn40.1:3.5: Yaṃ hi tam āvuso sammāvadamāno vadeyya ||
sn40.1:3.6: Satthārānuggahito sāvako mahābhiññatam pattoti || mamaṃ tam sammāvadamāno vadeyya
